category5.design: The OSS-Fuzz build already makes /src/jq/jq, the program the exploit runs (it only builds ./jq when missing); the PoC is its argument list. Crash rule. The injected off-by-one runs on every object rehash and jq's compiler builds an object of ~200 builtin names for every program, so every parsable program (the default `.` too) aborts the vulnerable build: degenerate, kept as such.
